integrity: The proof is noncomputational. The two nonstandard source theorems and the exact conjecture statement were inspected in the full public preprint. The new factor-heredity lemma is reconstructed directly from the definitions, and the only compactness input is König's infinity lemma. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result resolves the infinite-chain conjecture but not the stronger complete-tree conjecture over five letters. It relies on the published existence of arbitrarily long quaternary steady words and on the published theorem that steady words over fixed alphabets of size at least three are bifurcate.
title: Steady-word compactness resolves the quaternary bifurcate-chain conjecture
